verdict.rationale: Gram lets platform engineers bring their own OAuth provider/credentials (Auth0, Okta, Keycloak, or custom OAuth server) for MCP server authentication, satisfying the 'own OAuth app credentials' half of the story. However, there is no evidence of white-labeling the authorization flow's branding (custom logos, colors, domain, or consent screen customization). Missing for 10: evidence of branded/custom-domain authorization UI, logo/colour customization, or any white-label consent screen capability.
